title: OmniScore-Bench: Evaluating Vision-Language Models on Musical Score Reading
abstract: arXiv:2611.17870v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) can answer questions about musical scores, but their ability to recognise notation, recover its structure and interpret its musical meaning requires separate evaluation. Existing optical music recognition (OMR) resources establish detection and transcription measurements; a transcription score alone leaves the strengths and bottlenecks of a VLM score reader unresolved. We introduce OmniScore-Bench, an evaluation of OMR capabilities in VLMs through 3,000 questions spanning six aspects and 24 task subtypes. Each question specifies a visible scope, reference annotations and an answer schema, enabling automatic evaluation from symbol localisation to musical consistency and evidence-linked question answering. Our assessment of twelve VLMs reveals operation-specific capability profiles and different transcription leaders across excerpt, single-page and multipage tasks. translated_title: OmniScore-Bench：评估视觉语言模型在乐谱阅读上的能力
translated_abstract: 视觉语言模型（VLM）能够回答关于乐谱的问题，但它们识别记谱符号、恢复乐谱结构以及解读其音乐含义的能力需要单独评估。现有的光学音乐识别（OMR）资源已建立了检测和转录的度量标准，但仅凭转录分数无法确定VLM乐谱阅读器的优势与瓶颈所在。我们提出了OmniScore-Bench，通过涵盖六个方面和24种任务子类型的3000个问题来评估VLM中的OMR能力。每个问题都指定了可见范围、参考标注和答案模式，从而实现从符号定位、音乐一致性到基于证据的问答的自动化评估。我们对十二个VLM的评估揭示了针对不同操作类型的能力画像，以及在选段、单页和多页等不同转录任务上表现各异的领先模型。控制变量分析还考察了乐谱（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: OmniScore-Bench是一个包含3000个问题、覆盖六大方面和24种任务子类型的综合基准，用于系统评估视觉语言模型在乐谱阅读上的光学音乐识别能力，揭示了各模型从符号定位到证据关联问答等任务中的优势与瓶颈。
en_tdlr: OmniScore-Bench is a comprehensive benchmark of 3,000 questions spanning six aspects and 24 task subtypes that systematically evaluates VLMs' optical music recognition abilities in score reading, revealing their strengths and bottlenecks from symbol localisation to evidence-linked question answering.
